svg.title: organization program
svg.desc: A sitemap with square nodes, one above two, joined by a bar, cut from a blue-600 tile. Drawn on the drawn-mark box and rules (docs/favicons/README.md): solid fills, no strokes, and every gap at least 2.5 units, which is about 1.4 CSS pixels at 16. Chosen 2026-11-07 after tabler:sitemap-filled, squared to sit with the geometric marks; the ideas it was chosen from are in docs/prototypes/program-mark-ideas.html.
